annotation.title_clean: UAE National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2031
annotation.title_en: UAE National Strategy for Artificial Intelligence 2031
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Office of the Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, United Arab Emirates
annotation.summary_en: The UAE's national AI strategy aims to make the country a world AI leader by 2031 through eight objectives: branding, priority-sector deployment, ecosystem, government adoption, talent, research, data infrastructure and governance. It has no robotics-specific provisions; governance consists of a council review, a UAI seal of approval and international roundtables.
key_provisions_or_claims: Vision to be a leading AI nation by 2031, aligned with UAE Centennial 2071, targeting up to AED 335 billion in extra output
Eight strategic objectives, with priority sectors of energy, logistics, tourism, healthcare and cybersecurity
UAI Seal of Approval certification at public, private, institutional and product levels
UAE AI and Blockchain Council to review data, ethics and cybersecurity governance and oversee implementation
Global Governance of AI Roundtable and a proposed intergovernmental panel on AI
